messages:
Nina V: morning! i'm setting up my first-week checklist and need access to the console to verify feature-flag gating for the onboarding flow. who can grant staging access? :slightly_smiling_face:
Ops-Ryan: hi @Nina V, congrats on joining! i can give staging console admin for 24h. do you also need experiment telemetry access (grafana) or just flag toggles?
Nina V: both would be great if possible. i'll be running a quick smoke test on the new onboarding modal.
Talia H: welcome Nina! i'll pair with you on the smoke test tomorrow if that helps. for access, we give new hires a 24-48h window depending on scope.
Nina V: awesome, thanks. Ryan, what's the command you run?
Ops-Ryan: i use the infra tool:
```
infractl access grant --user nina.v --roles console-admin-staging,staging-observability --ttl 24h --reason "onboarding smoke test"
```
Security-Bot: Note: Prod toggles require a change ticket and 2 approvals. Also, do not store tokens in plaintext; use the secrets service.
Nina V: understood. i'll keep tokens in vault. does staging admin let me create temporary overrides or only toggle existing flags?
Ops-Ryan: staging admin can create overrides and set percentage rollouts. prod admin is more restricted.
Nina V: thanks, i'll try the smoke test after pairing with Talia and report results here.
Infra-Bot: Access event logged: user=nina.v actor=ops-ryan roles=console-admin-staging,staging-observability expires=177338...
Talia H: ping me when you're ready and i'll hop on the call. welcome again! :tada:
